title: Power Apps: form fill assistance using Microsoft 365 files in model-driven apps
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licence requirements and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should flag the gradual admin-control rollout, include environment selection in the app-designer route, and remove the checklist's table-level enablement instruction because the controls table has no corresponding row.
